figurative_meaning_bn: পুণ্যকাহিনি শ্রবণে যে ফল পাওয়া যায়
figurative_meaning_en: The reward or benefit obtained from listening to virtuous or pious stories
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকাল ফলশ্রুতি পাওয়া কঠিন হয়ে গেছে, কারণ পুণ্যকথা শোনার সময় নেই।
বাবা বললেন, এই কাহিনি শুনে ফলশ্রুতি লাভ করবে।
example_sentences_in_english: These days, it's hard to gain the fruits of hearing pious tales because there's no time to listen.
Father said, by listening to this story, you will receive the spiritual reward.
history: Refers to traditional Bengali practice of listening to religious or moral stories for spiritual merit, often in rural or semi-rural settings during festivals or gatherings.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu concepts of punya (merit) gained through auditory exposure to sacred narratives.
